Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to open authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia pages for Paul Bettany and Jennifer Connelly) and instead repeatedly surfaced DuckDuckGo results, relying on an auto-generated “Search Assist” snippet that incorrectly stated Paul Bettany is married to “actress David Dugan.” This over-reliance on an unreliable snippet and not opening credible sources introduced and risked propagating a wrong spouse, directly undermining the task’s accuracy.
